koruma.soru:
No restore point could be created because System Protection is off on drive {surucu}.

Turn it on? This will:
• Turn on System Protection for drive {surucu}
• Reserve up to {gb} GB for restore points (free space: {bos} GB; the oldest points are deleted as it fills)
• Create the first restore point and check that it really exists

To turn it off later: Control Panel > System > System protection > Configure.
koruma.servis_not: Required service(s) are disabled: {liste}. They will be set back to the Windows default (Manual).
koruma.aciliyor: Turning on System Protection and creating the first restore point. This can take a minute…
koruma.engel.ilke: System Restore is turned off by Group Policy on this PC ("Turn off System Restore"). This is usually an administrator or organisation setting, so the app will not force it on. To change it: gpedit.msc > Computer Configuration > Administrative Templates > System > System Restore, or ask whoever manages this PC.
koruma.engel.ilke_ayar: System Protection settings are locked by Group Policy on this PC ("Turn off Configuration"). The app will not force them. To change it: gpedit.msc > Computer Configuration > Administrative Templates > System > System Restore, or ask whoever manages this PC.
koruma.engel.servis_yok: The Volume Shadow Copy (VSS) service needed for restore points was not found on this Windows (it may have been removed). System Protection cannot be turned on; Windows needs a repair (sfc /scannow, DISM).
koruma.engel.disk: There is not enough free space on drive {surucu} for restore points. Free up a few GB and try again.
koruma.sonuc.servis: The {ad} service was set back to Manual start.
koruma.sonuc.ac: System Protection could not be turned on. Windows said: {hata}
koruma.sonuc.dogrulanamadi: Windows reported no error, but when the drive was read again System Protection still looks off, so it is not counted as turned on. Try turning it on manually in Control Panel > System > System protection.
koruma.sonuc.acildi: System Protection is now on for drive {surucu} (confirmed by reading it again).
koruma.sonuc.sinir: Up to {gb} GB is reserved for restore points.
koruma.sonuc.sinir_hata: The reserved space could not be set or confirmed; Windows' own default limit applies.
koruma.sonuc.siklik: The first restore point was not created. Windows does not create a new one until {dk} minutes have passed since the last, and skips it without an error. Protection is on; a point will be created on the next change once that time has passed.

ui.wu.aciklama.varsayilan: Leaves Windows Update to Windows' own settings. If the app applied a mode before, the previous values are restored.
ui.wu.aciklama.guvenlik: Feature (major version) updates are deferred 365 days and quality updates 4 days; drivers do not come from Windows Update; updates are downloaded but you are asked before they install. Same values as Chris Titus Tech WinUtil's 'Security Settings'.
ui.wu.aciklama.duraklat: Extends Windows' 'Pause updates' setting until 1 January 2100. During this time security updates do NOT arrive either. No service is disabled and no file is deleted; undo it with 'Default'.
ui.wu.arti.guvenlik: Security patches arrive within a few days; no surprise major versions or drivers
ui.wu.arti.duraklat: No update downloads or unexpected restarts while gaming
ui.wu.eksi.guvenlik: New Windows features arrive a year late; you have to update drivers such as the graphics driver yourself
ui.wu.eksi.duraklat: Security holes stay open; some games, Microsoft Store and anti-cheat systems may require an up-to-date Windows
ui.wu.dokunmamali.guvenlik: Computers managed by a company or school
ui.wu.dokunmamali.duraklat: Anyone who browses the web, opens email or does online banking; managed computers
ui.wu.dikkat.guvenlik: Because policy values are written, Settings may say 'Some settings are managed by your organization'; this is normal.
ui.wu.dikkat.duraklat: This method relies on undocumented Windows values and was not tested on this computer; Windows may reset the limit itself in the future. Switch back to 'Default' from time to time and install updates.
ui.wu.not: Turning Windows Update off completely (disabling its services) is deliberately not offered: it is hard to undo and Windows often turns it back on by itself.

ui.uac.aciklama.karartmasiz: Same as the default but the screen does not dim. The window opens on top of other programs; another program could imitate or click it.
ui.uac.aciklama.hic: No confirmation window at all: if you are signed in as an administrator, programs get administrator rights without asking. UAC is not fully turned off (Microsoft Store apps keep working).
ui.uac.arti: Fewer confirmation windows; fewer interruptions when installing games and tools
ui.uac.eksi.her_zaman: A confirmation window also appears when changing settings
ui.uac.eksi.karartmasiz: The window does not open on the secure desktop; a malicious program could imitate it
ui.uac.eksi.hic: Malicious programs can get administrator rights without being noticed
ui.uac.geri_alma: Undo it with 'Restore' on the Changes page or with the 'Notify only when apps make changes' level.

ui.uac.not: Turning UAC fully off (EnableLUA=0) is intentionally not offered: it breaks Microsoft Store apps and runs every program as administrator.

ui.tarayici.bilgi:
Extensions run inside the browser; they affect an open browser, not the game itself. If the browser stays open while you play, enabled extensions use memory and CPU. The effect is usually small and was not measured in this app; closing the browser before gaming is the surest way.

The "runs on all sites" mark means the extension can read and change every page. It is a privacy notice, not a slowness indicator.

The app does not change extensions. To turn one off, open the browser's extensions page (chrome://extensions, edge://extensions or brave://extensions in the address bar; about:addons for Firefox). fps_servis.amd3dvcacheSvc: On dual-CCD Ryzen X3D processors it sends the game to the V-Cache cores. If DISABLED, FPS may drop.

fps_servis.XblGameSave: For cloud saves; no FPS benefit.
fps_servis.XboxNetApiSvc: For Xbox networking; no FPS benefit.
fps_servis.XboxGipSvc: For Xbox controllers/accessories; no FPS benefit.
fps_servis.Spooler: The print service; uses almost no CPU while idle, no effect on FPS is observed.
fps_servis.WerSvc: Runs only when a program crashes; no effect on FPS.

ui.oyun_bilgi.hazir_ayar:
The three presets fill in this game's system-side settings with one click:

• Visual priority: does not push the system (priority Normal, leaves cores and power alone). With two graphics cards it sends the game to the powerful one.
• Balanced: priority Above Normal, exempt from power throttling, notifications off. On an AMD X3D (large-cache) CPU it pins the game to the big-cache cores.
• Performance: on top of Balanced, priority High, a game power plan and a low-priority Steam. X3D uses the cache cores, Intel hybrid uses the performance cores.

None of them changes the game's own graphics settings. Pausing services, stopping Windows Search and standby clearing are never turned on by any preset (risky or situational). These values are not a promised gain; they are a starting point. You can see the effect with the Before/After measurement.
ui.oyun_otomatik_kapali: Automatic apply is off: when you save, this game's permanent settings return to the Windows default and its in-game settings are not applied. Your choices are kept.
ui.oyun_gelismis_aciklama: Most players do not need these. In-game settings are undone when the game closes.
ui.oyun_kaydet_aciklama: Priority, graphics card and full-screen settings are written now; the others are applied when the game starts.
ui.oyun_bilgi.otomatik: When on, this game's settings are applied automatically every time it starts and undone when it closes.
ui.oyun_bilgi.oncelik: Processor priority makes Windows give the game CPU time before other programs; 'Above normal' is enough for most games.
ui.oyun_bilgi.cekirdek: Chooses which processor cores the game runs on; if unsure, leave it on 'All cores'.
ui.oyun_bilgi.bildirim: Silences Windows notifications and their sounds while the game runs (Do not disturb).
ui.oyun_bilgi.boost: When the game starts, programs that are open and on the Boost page list are closed POLITELY without asking (the program is first sent a close request). Programs that do not close are not force-ended, they are left open and you are told. Closed programs do not reopen by themselves when the game ends. There is a risk of losing unsaved work; only put programs in your list that you really do not need while playing. The game itself is never closed even if it is on the list.
ui.oyun_bilgi.gpu: On computers with two graphics cards, makes the game run on the powerful (dedicated) card.
ui.oyun_bilgi.fso: Full-screen optimizations merge the game's full screen with Windows' window system; turning them off can reduce latency in some older games.
ui.oyun_bilgi.guc_kismasi_muaf: Prevents Windows' background power saving (EcoQoS), which slows programs down, from being applied to the game.
ui.oyun_bilgi.servisleri_duraklat: Stops some background services while the game runs and starts them again when it closes.
ui.oyun_bilgi.windows_search_durdur: Stops file indexing (Windows Search) while the game runs; searching in the Start menu is slower meanwhile.
ui.oyun_bilgi.steam_dusuk_oncelik: Lowers the processor priority of Steam's background interface process while the game runs.

ui.bilgi.amac: Forevermore is a Windows settings app for gamers. It scans your PC read-only and shows the settings that actually work, with what they do and their pros and cons; placebo and harmful settings are marked separately. Every change is backed up and can be undone with one click.
ui.bilgi.hikaye: I have been into computers and optimization as a hobby for a long time. Because there is so much fake news, misleading settings and baseless optimization online, I wanted to design a simple, easy-to-use app based on my own tests, benchmarks and experience. Forevermore is a university student's hobby project.
ui.bilgi.katkida_aciklama: Thanks to everyone who tested and supported the app.

olcum.aciklama: Take a 'Before' measurement before applying settings and an 'After' measurement after applying them (and restarting if needed); the app compares the two. Results are stored on this computer only.
olcum.durustluk: Honest warning: a single measurement is not proof. Results vary with background activity, temperature and the scene. Under the same conditions (same scene, same duration, same open programs), take at least 3 measurements each and compare the averages. Small differences (below 3%) are often measurement noise.
olcum.sistem_aciklama: Boot time (from the event log), startup apps and tasks, services, idle CPU/memory and process count. Do not use the computer during the measurement; the most accurate result is a few minutes after the computer starts.
olcum.sistem_suruyor: Measuring the system ({sn} s). Please do not use the computer…
olcum.oyun_aciklama: Intel PresentMon measures average FPS, 1% and 0.1% low FPS and frame time. PresentMon does not inject into the game; it reads Windows event traces.
olcum.oyun_ipucu: Open the game and always go to the same scene (e.g. the same map, the same round). After 'Start measurement', go back to the game during the {sn}-second countdown; only time with the game in the foreground counts.
olcum.not_ac_tam_ekran: PresentMon does not inject into the game; it reads Windows event logs (ETW), so it is not expected to conflict with anti-cheat such as VAC (still, measure in practice mode, not an online match). In exclusive fullscreen, alt-tab minimises the game and the counter stops: borderless window is recommended.
olcum.ozel_tam_ekran: The game was running in exclusive fullscreen: alt-tab stops the measurement. Switch to borderless window and try again.
olcum.oyun_suruyor: Measuring {surec}: {sn}/{toplam} s. Keep playing in the same scene…
olcum.presentmon_yok: PresentMon was not found. Download the PresentMon console version from the official release page on GitHub (github.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon, MIT license) and put it in the 'tools' folder next to the program.
olcum.hata_az_kare: Not enough frames were recorded during the measurement. Make sure the game is open and in the foreground and that the process name is correct.

olcum.neden.yakalama: Capture or system problem: PresentMon recorded no frames from any process (the Windows desktop included). Windows event tracing (ETW) may have failed to start or been blocked.
olcum.neden.surec: Capture works (frames came from the Windows desktop) but none came from the selected process. It may be the wrong process (for example the launcher instead of the game), or the game was not running during the measurement.

ui.anti_cheat_genel: Some anti-cheats may block CPU priority and core changes. If blocked, the app skips that setting and says so in the status bar.
ui.anti_cheat_oyun: This game has {liste}. Settings such as core selection and priority may be blocked; if so, they are skipped and you are told. Anti-cheat processes are never touched. No record was found of anyone being banned for these settings alone, but that is not a guarantee; if you have doubts, do not turn on core/priority settings for this game.
